about: Mods for Claude Code made by other people, listed and checked by modmyclaude. Criteria and what "checked" means: COMMUNITY.md in this repo.

mods.name: context-bar
mods.title: Context Bar
mods.summary: One bar above the prompt, split by what fills the context window.
mods.author: hamzafer
mods.says: One bar split by what fills the window; reads the cache lifetime from the session transcript (docs/mods.md).

passed: no undeclared network or model calls
pending: installs on the current Claude Code, terminal and desktop

mods.name: image-view
mods.title: Image View
mods.summary: Thumbnails of pasted images above the prompt, made on your machine.
mods.author: jarrodwatts
mods.says: Local only, no network; reads the prompt box and Claude Code's temp image cache; runs sips for non-PNG pastes and writes one PNG thumbnail (README, Security).

passed: no undeclared network or model calls
pending: installs on the current Claude Code, terminal and desktop

mods.name: filetree
mods.title: Filetree
mods.summary: An IDE-style file tree pane with git status, Quick Look and open-in-editor.
mods.author: data-goblin
mods.says: git status and git or gh operations, Quick Look on macOS, open with the default app or your editor in tmux or herdr (README).
reach: runs programs (git, gh, find, du, tmux, herdr, qlmanage, osascript)
writes and removes temp marker files
sees every tool call and prompt
mods.notes: The README does not yet name osascript, which it uses to bring Quick Look forward.

mods.name: hal-grammar-check
mods.title: HAL Grammar Check
mods.summary: A grammar check of your prompt as you type, through Claude Haiku on your own account or a local Ollama.
mods.author: vinta
mods.says: The first 500 characters of your draft go to the model: claude/haiku through your Claude account, or ollama/ to localhost:11434 only (README, Privacy).
reach: model calls (Claude Haiku on your account, or a local Ollama)
runs curl to the local Ollama
sees your prompt as you type
